about: Fixed words for the end-of-session map (R-13). The encouragement is picked from what happened (problems solved, first tries), about effort, never about being smart. Every state the map draws has its words here, so the legend and the boxes always agree.

encouragement.none: Showing up is the hard part, and you did it. Next time, these start to move.
encouragement.all_first_try: Every problem right on the first try. You practiced {skills} today.
encouragement.most_first_try: {first} of {solved} right on the first try, and you fixed the rest. You practiced {skills} today.
encouragement.kept_going: Some of these were hard, and you kept going. You practiced {skills} today.
